description: This file contains C code for serializing (dumping) precompiled Lua chunks, including functions for dumping constants, debug info, and the main dump function luaU_dump.

methods.name: DumpBlock
methods.description: Serializes a block of memory if the dump status is OK.

methods.name: DumpConstants
methods.description: Serializes the constants of a Proto object.

methods.name: DumpDebug
methods.description: Serializes debug information of a Proto object.

methods.name: DumpHeader
methods.description: Serializes the header for the dump.

methods.name: luaU_dump
methods.description: Main function to dump a Lua function as a precompiled chunk.
